//: Non-secret defaults for the unit test suite.
Real credentials are NOT here. CI supplies them as environment variables, which take precedence
over this file, and a developer running locally puts their own in user secrets. The values below
are deliberately synthetic so the suite constructs its configuration objects and runs; any test
that genuinely needs a live service will still fail without the real values, which is honest.
Synthetic values follow the repo's sensitive-data policy: zeroed GUIDs and contoso hostnames.
TenantGUID is deliberately NOT zeroed. Office365FakeController uses default(Guid) as its
'this is the next page, do not paginate again' sentinel, so a zeroed tenant makes the fake
withhold the NextPageUri header and every paging test silently imports exactly half of what it
expects. The value below is still obviously synthetic.
